generalCriterionList.description: Tenderers shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government/Government of India /Union Territory.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the date of submission of Tenders.

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/documents furnished by the bidder should the circumstances so warrant. In case the information or the document furnished is found to be incorrect/false or invalid then the EMD furnished by such bidder shall be forfeited.
Right to reject any or all the bidders without assigning any reasons rests with the accepting authority.
The successful bidder shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act.
The successful bidder shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers working in this area.
The bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF and as per the applicable rates as issued by the PF department from time to time.
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, royalty etc., at the prevailing applicable rates.

The successful bidder should maintain the register of labour deployed and the wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority and remittance towards PF shall commensurate with the labour component for the work involved.
The bidder should have independents PF code. The contractor shall remit PF of labours to contractors permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub-code.
The bidder shall produce the ESI registration certificate if applicable and if the work awarded to them.

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and but inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1% etc., as per the latest GoK and GoI prevailing rules in the website itself.
The Tenderer shall take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and as same as point 4 (i) of special conditions of contract.
If the bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contracts or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejections.
Bidder should follow the minimum wages act with respect to labour wages as issued by labour department time to time.
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day shall be reckoned.
Any other information required may be obtained from the office of the undersigned during office hours.
Within 20 days of receipt, the successful Tenderer should sign the Agreement and deliver it to the Employer.

Within 20 days of receipt of the letter of acceptance, the successful tenderer shall deliver to the employer a security deposit in form of e-BG only for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract price excluding GST at the time of entering into an agreement with KPCL, and shall be valid for entire contract period from the date of agreement.
The tender document shall be available for download free of cost from date and time of publication in the Karnataka Public Procurement Portal till last date and time or the extend time.

Aspiring bidders/contractors who have not obtained the user ID and Password for participating in e-procurement in Karnataka Power Corporation Limited may now obtain the same from the website (https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in).

Corrigendum/addendum/clarifications, if any will be notified on the e-procurement website (https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in) For any further information contact Office of The Executive Engineer (RTM), Bellary Thermal Power Station Karnataka Power Corporation Ltd Kudathini 583 152, Ballari (Dist) Mobile 9141607287 during office working hours (i.e from 09:30AM to 05:30PM)

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Reconstruction of Damaged Bearing Pedestals of Wagon Tippler 1 at CHP BTPS

itemList.description: Dismantling the damaged RCC Bearing pedestal carefully without damaging the adjoining structures provided for tippling arrangement of Wagon tippler-1 in the restricted area, including stacking of steel bars and disposal of unserviceable material to the appropriate disposal area. Removing disturbed concrete in the beam/slab to the required depth for tying with new Fe550 steel bars of 25mm/12mm diameter for the pedestal (as per drawing) with existing rods in place of cut length. for lap length extensions and structural continuity, steel bars shall be installed using HILTI injuction chemical adhesive system to execute reliable lap splices and anchorages into the existing concrete elements in accordence with the manufacturer's specification. Providing, aligning and fixing in position 24mm dia bolts of Grade 8.8 HT 1400 mm long as per drawing. Applying epoxy bonding of new concrete to old concrete complete as per specifications. Casting the TWO no's of pedestals (bottom dimension 2250mm x 1100mm with tapering top dimension 1500mm x 750mm and 1450mm depth) with M30 grade concrete using 20mm and down coarse aggregates and 28 days cube compressive strength not less than 30N/sqmm (300kg/sqcm) Cement content = 480kg/cum using approved clean, hard, graded aggregates. This includes cost of all materials, machinery, labour, formwork, centering, scaffolding, cleaning, batching, mixing, placing in position, levelling, vibrating, finishing and grouting the base plate with non-shrink grout mix of approved quality.complete with all lead and lifts and as directed by the engineer in -charge at site.
